messages.subject: Upcoming #maptimeDavis Workshops: RSpatial.org & Drone Show & Tell
parts:
The next two weeks in the #maptimeDavis workshop series are just as exciting as our previous workshops!  Please visit the links provided for a more detailed description including necessary preparation and a link to RSVP for each of them.

 

Intro to RSpatial.org - October 16, 2:10-4:00 – DSI Classroom (360 Shields Library): https://spatial.ucdavis.edu/2017/10/09/maptimedavis-rspatial-org/ Get started with using R for spatial data!  This is the first of our two R for spatial data workshops.

 

UAV/Drone Show & Tell – October 23, 2:30-3:30 – 2005 PES (Plant & Environmental Sciences): https://spatial.ucdavis.edu/2017/10/09/maptimedavis-uavdrone-show-tell/ *** Note the different time and location for this workshop ***  This will be an open-house style event, so attendees may come and go at any time during the event.  See UAV research equipment in person and talk with researchers!

 

The full #maptimeDavis workshop series schedule is online here: https://spatial.ucdavis.edu/2017/09/18/maptimedavis-workshop-series/  #maptimeDavis is brought to you by the UC Davis Library’s Data Management Program & the UC Davis Center for Spatial Sciences with help from several campus clubs and informal learning groups. Space is generously provided by the Data Science Initiative (DSI).

 

 

See you soon!

 

Michele
